settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Your choice is remembered on this device.
settings.aboutBody: Your plants, photos and care history are stored on your own computer, in the app's storage folder. Species care guides come from the version-controlled catalog.

ai.title: AI features
ai.notConfiguredHint: To use AI features, add an OpenAI API key to the .env file next to compose.yaml, then restart the app.
ai.privacy: AI features only run when you use one. Then the photo, the plant's details and its recent care history are sent to OpenAI for analysis. Nothing else leaves your computer, and the requests aren't saved in your OpenAI account.
